name: The Sunken Fountain
description: A fountain that has been underwater for years. The water is black, and the carved names on its lip seem to shift when unobserved.

exits.label: To the Old Breach
exits.hiddenDescription: A path that only appears after the fountain has been touched at Deep Night.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Carved Lip
pointsOfInterest.description: Names carved in an order you do not yet understand.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Black Water
pointsOfInterest.description: Water that is not wet. Memory held in surface tension.

name: The Archive Steps
description: The Luminous Archive rises like a held breath. Rows of shelves extend into shadow, each holding records of things that should not have survived.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Master Index
pointsOfInterest.description: Coded references to records you cannot yet access.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Silent Bells
pointsOfInterest.description: Bells that ring in frequencies you feel rather than hear.

name: Greywake Market
description: A market that trades in memories, debts, and silence. The stalls are arranged by how much light they permit.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Debt Court
pointsOfInterest.description: A court that judges by memories people never confessed.

name: The Old Breach
description: Where the Shattered entered. The wound in reality has not healed. It has learned to hide.

pointsOfInterest.name: The Wound
pointsOfInterest.description: Reality is thin here. You can see through to something that is not quite sky.
